name: market-growth-raw-intake-v0.1
purpose: Minimum raw comparison payload required to re-enter JOB-MARKET-GROWTH-001 without inventing unobserved events.

constraints.note: Rows are only comparable when baseline and full_v1 share the same seed and turn.

reentry_ready_when: at least one seed has paired baseline/full_v1 rows covering turn 2 through 120
self_action and opponent_action are present for each paired turn
boundary: This contract defines data sufficiency only. It does not assert causality or predict terminal outcome.
